# Hype Legal

> Hype Legal is a boutique digital marketing agency specializing in premium branding, website design, and SEO for law firms seeking measurable growth. The agency serves personal injury, mass tort, litigation, and trial firms across the United States, operating fully remote.

## Who We Serve

Law firms across the United States, with a focus on personal injury, mass tort, litigation, and trial practices seeking premium digital marketing and measurable growth.
